discoveries.name: LangChain Harness Engineering Blog
discoveries.why: Empirical methodology for improving agent performance via harness-only changes (52.8% -> 66.5% on Terminal Bench 2.0). Introduces reasoning sandwich pattern, LoopDetection middleware, PreCompletionChecklist middleware, and Trace Analyzer Skill.

discoveries.name: LangChain Autonomous Context Compression
discoveries.why: Model-triggered compaction at clean task boundaries instead of hard token thresholds. Most transferable context management idea for our orchestrator.

discoveries.name: LangChain Context Management for DeepAgents
discoveries.why: Three-tier compression strategy technical deep-dive: offload large outputs, offload large inputs at 85% threshold, summarization as last resort.

discoveries.name: The Anatomy of an Agent Harness (LangChain)
discoveries.why: Defines framework vs runtime vs harness taxonomy. 'A raw model is not an agent. But it becomes one when a harness gives it state, tool execution, feedback loops, and enforceable constraints.'

discoveries.name: Harrison Chase on Context Engineering (Sequoia Podcast)
discoveries.why: Sequoia interview with LangChain CEO on context engineering for long-horizon agents. Likely contains architectural insights on DeepAgents' design philosophy.

discoveries.name: NVIDIA AI-Q Research Assistant Blueprint
discoveries.why: Hybrid model routing (frontier for orchestration, Nemotron for research) cuts costs 50% while topping DeepResearch Bench. Source code for the architecture pattern.

discoveries.name: Harbor (LangChain hosted deployment)
discoveries.why: Hosted deployment platform for DeepAgents agents. Referenced as the sandbox orchestration layer using Daytona.

discoveries.name: Terminal Bench 2.0
discoveries.why: 89-task benchmark across ML, debugging, biology used to measure harness engineering improvements. Referenced in harness engineering blog.
